_comment: Registry of all CI test suites. Each suite is auto-discovered and run by run_ci_tests.py. Add new test suites by adding entries here without modifying CI workflows.

test_suites.name: Golden Impedance Matrix (Regression Floor)
test_suites.description: Core antenna impedance validation against nec2c reference. All 12 points must pass at 1e-4 relative tolerance.

test_suites.name: Golden Impedance Matrix (Open Issues)
test_suites.description: Known failing impedance tests blocked on open issues (e.g., Issue #14). Currently contains deck 11 only. Expected to fail until issue is closed.
